# Golf Nets Unlimited

> Golf Nets Unlimited, a division of Nets Unlimited, Inc. (AZ ROC #236070) in Phoenix, Arizona, designs, fabricates, and installs custom golf ball deterrent netting systems for homeowners, HOAs, golf courses, and driving ranges.

Key facts:

- Company: Golf Nets Unlimited, an operating division of Nets Unlimited, Inc., a licensed, bonded, and insured contractor (AZ ROC #236070).
- Address: 20625 N. 29th Place, Phoenix, AZ 85050, United States.
- Phone: (480) 515-1300. Email: info@netsunlimited.com.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 4:00 pm (Arizona time). Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Service area: installs mainly in Arizona; travels for installation anywhere; ships netting worldwide and can supply netting to your own contractor.
- Materials: schedule 40 galvanized steel poles (black by default, powder-coat or paint to match HOA or home colors); high-performance polyester or nylon netting with a polypropylene rope border. Common net colors: black, beige, white, green.
- Warranty: 1 year on material and workmanship for new structures; 10-year pro-rated UV-degradation warranty on netting.
- Cost: varies by site, from a few hundred to several thousand dollars. Estimates are free, by phone or on site.
- Process: 50% deposit to order, balance on completion. Site plan provided for approval, HOA approval support included. Installation usually takes 2 to 5 days.
- Also sold: netting only (material purchase), net replacement and repairs on existing sound structures.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://golfnetsunlimited.com/): Overview of golf ball deterrent netting systems for homes, communities, and courses.
- [Homeowners](https://golfnetsunlimited.com/homeowners): Residential golf ball deterrent netting, low-visibility structures, and patio and window net infill panels.
- [Driving Range & Practice](https://golfnetsunlimited.com/driving-range): Driving range, tee box, hitting net, and cart path protection netting for golf courses and practice facilities.
- [HOA](https://golfnetsunlimited.com/hoa): Golf protection netting for HOAs and golf-course communities, including drawings, samples, and design guidelines for uniform installs.
- [Other Nets](https://golfnetsunlimited.com/other-nets): Batting cages, sport court containment, kids' climbs, aviaries, pet netting, shade structures, handrails, bridges, tunnels, and thatch.
